newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.

text.p: Stocks are forecast to weaken on consolidation on Friday, but blue chips and export manufacturers are likely to rebound later in the day, brokers said.
They said the expected consolidation was in response to the rally sparked earlier this week by brisk trade account figures.
"Stocks will likely remain weak or mixed early today but blue chips and export manufacturers are seen rebounding later," said LG Securities broker Koh Soon-shik.
On Thursday the composite index fell 2.03 points to 775.26 on broad profit-taking selling.
Brokers said the planned liberalisation of interest rates on bank savings accounts was not expected to have a major impact on the stock market trading.
The Bank of Korea said on Thursday it would allow banks to set interest rates on savings accounts, effective July 7.
